about: The Editor's last Claude review (house style, facts, tone, premium visuals).
summary: No Never-list breaches in the captions, but 2026-11-24-tue falls short of the premium visual standard and 2026-12-03-thu duplicates 2026-11-26-thu; I could only see images for the first post.
points: 2026-11-24-tue (card): the 'FREE · NO SIGN-UP' banner overlaps the in-game hole label and GolfPrice AI badge, so 'GolfPric…' and 'AI' are clipped. Fix: move or shrink the banner, or crop the screenshot above the label and badge.

2026-11-24-tue (thumbnail): the raw game screenshot is soft and upscaled. Game UI fragments are cut off at the edges ('Island Green', 'Tee', '11 mph', 'hape') and the in-game text ('Drag back from anywhere', 'Full Swing. Not full price.') is tiny and clutters it. Fix: use a sharp, tightly cropped course view with no menu chrome. Keep the 2-4 big words in the middle 4:5 and make the headline match the video's hook.
2026-11-24-tue (card/thumbnail): the thumbnail is a 9:16 crop of the same screenshot as the card. Use a different composition so the two do not look identical.

2026-11-24-tue (video): I could not view the three video frames. The folder held only the mp4, and there is no ffmpeg here and I couldn't install a decoder. Someone needs to check pace, the hook in the first second and the frames by eye before this goes out.
2026-12-03-thu: same product, price, hook and caption as 2026-11-26-thu, so two posts in the week are nearly identical. Fix: swap in a different product or angle, or drop one.

2026-11-26-thu / 2026-12-03-thu: 'Good time to buy' leans towards pushing a purchase. The TikTok and YouTube lines say 'lowest price we've ever tracked' while the other captions say 'in 81 days'. Fix: use the 81-day wording everywhere and drop 'Good time to buy'.

2026-11-24-tue: '1 in 10,000' hole-in-one odds must come from the game's own data (please confirm). The Instagram caption has two hashtag blocks, and '#golfdeals #golfgear' don't fit a game post. Fix: keep one block.

2026-11-25-wed / 2026-12-02-wed: YouTube titles repeat 'The Fourball:' and are cut off at '#go'. Pinterest titles end in a stray colon ('Big Dave's par: '). Fix: dedupe, shorten and strip the trailing colon.

2026-11-25-wed, 2026-11-27-fri, 2026-11-29-sun, 2026-12-04-fri, 2026-12-06-sun: '#golfdeals #golfgear' on posts with no deal. 2026-11-27-fri and 2026-12-04-fri have the doubled phrasing 'Settle it in the comments Answers in the comments'. Fix: tidy.
Posts other than 2026-11-24-tue: no card, thumbnail or frames were provided, so only the text was reviewed and their visuals are unchecked.
